body: Pressure messages often use hurry, authority, comfort or a kill-switch.
action: Which H.A.C.K. signal do you see?

body: If you never entered, the prize is probably bait.
action: Check the real account first.

body: That code can hand over your account.
action: Keep recovery codes private.

body: Unofficial downloads can bring more than the game.
action: Use trusted sources.

body: A copied account can still look familiar.
action: Talk to your friend another way.

body: A real job should not charge you to start.
action: Never pay to get hired.

body: You noticed something worth checking.
action: Pause · Assess · Talk.

body: A QR code can hide the destination.
action: Check where it leads before you sign in.

body: If you didn't start it, someone else may be trying.
action: Deny it. Secure the account.

body: The deal may be after your password, not your money.
action: Open the real service yourself.

body: AI can copy faces and voices.
action: Check the source before you react.

body: A crowded group chat can still carry a bad link.
action: Check before you join the rush.

body: A fake alert can still look official.
action: Open the real school portal yourself.

body: Paying or sending more usually does not end the pressure.
action: Stop. Save evidence. Tell a trusted adult.

body: Easy money can turn you into the middle of a scam.
action: Do not move money for strangers.

body: A cloned voice can still ask for the wrong thing.
action: Voice-check through a trusted contact.

body: Scarcity can make a bad deal feel urgent.
action: Use the official ticket platform.

body: A fake reset link can steal the real password.
action: Open the real app or site yourself.

body: Feelings can be real while the identity is fake.
action: Do not send money. Talk to someone you trust.

body: Guaranteed returns are a classic warning sign.
action: Slow down before money leaves your account.

body: A tiny fee can be bait for your card details.
action: Check the delivery app directly.

body: Small details can reveal where you live, study or hang out.
action: Share less than strangers need to know.

body: A good cause can still use a fake payment page.
action: Check the real organisation first.

body: A scary pop-up is not proof your device is infected.
action: Close it. Use your real security tools.

body: Images, chats and receipts can all be edited or generated.
action: Check the source, not just the screenshot.

body: One stolen password can unlock more than one account.
action: Use unique passwords.

body: You do not have to react on someone else's timing.
action: Pause · Assess · Talk.
